mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% for 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and amplifying equity cash flow returns, leading to positive 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not stay below 2.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0% triggers negative 5-day SPX returns as high inflation expectations reduce equity valuations and investor risk aversion.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not sustain above 3.0% for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% and rise in GDPC1 (demand) above 19895 (t-6mo) over 2 months triggers positive 20-day SPX returns as policy easing and robust demand growth reinforce market optimism.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and GDPC1 > 19895 (t-6mo) over next 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not move in expected directions simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%), a sustained FEDFUNDS decline below 2.0% for 3 months predicts positive 60-day SPX returns as policy accommodation supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not stay below 2.0% for 3 consecutive months in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly PAYEMS exceeding 155,000 persons triggers negative 5-day SPX returns as labor market tightness raises wage inflation expectations and investor risk aversion.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or PAYEMS does not sustain above 155,000 for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing supply growth (INDPRO < 104.5) predicts positive 20-day SPX returns as market anticipates scarcity-driven price increases and demand surges.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not stay below 104.5 for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in GDPC1 (demand) above 19895 (t-6mo) and HOUST (industrial production) above 1575 (t-2mo) triggers positive 20-day SPX returns as dual demand indicators confirm expansion momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not move in expected directions simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Post-shock recovery regime (RSAFS > 683,974 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) predicts positive 60-day SPX returns as retail sales growth and accommodative policy signal market confidence and investment.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not move in expected directions simultaneously.
